programme.title: Football: UEFA Super Cup – studio
Piłka nożna: Superpuchar UEFA: Paris Saint-Germain – Aston Villa FC
programme.desc: The previous fight for the Super Cup took place in Udine. At Stadio Friuli, Paris Saint-Germain defeated Tottenham after a series of penalties, even though they were losing 0-2 to the Londoners until the 85th minute of the match. Now the arena of the match will be the Red Bull Arena in Salzburg, and representatives of French and English football will once again face each other. On May 30, PSG defeated Arsenal, becoming the best club on the Old Continent for the second time in a row. Thus, Ousmane Dembélé and company referred to the achievement of Real Madrid, which after 1992 was the only one to defend the title in the UEFA Champions League era. Aston Villa won the Europa League after a 3-0 victory over German team Freiburg. It was the first international triumph for Lviv in over 43 years. There is a chance that the fans of the Birmingham team will not have to wait long for another success for their favorites. Unai Emery has extensive experience in the European Super Cup. This prestigious trophy passed him by when he was the coach of Sevilla and Villarreal. Will the Spaniard break his bad streak at the helm of Aston Villa, which will not be the favorite in the confrontation with PSG?

programme.title: 30 for 30: The '85 Bears
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: d/s Seconds before disaster (Bloody massacre at the Olympics in Munich)
programme.desc: The organizers of the 1972 Munich Olympics had high hopes for it, hoping to show the world a new Germany, reborn after World War II. The optimistic start to the Olympics did not in any way foreshadow its tragic ending, when at four o'clock in the afternoon Palestinian terrorists killed two Israeli athletes and took 9 more athletes hostage. The police tried to somehow cope with the situation and come to an agreement with the terrorists, but they controlled their every step and did not make any concessions. On September 6, the police launched an assault, which ended at 13:30. As a result of the assault, all the athletes, five terrorists and one German policeman were killed. The wife of one of the athletes, faced with the reluctance of the authorities to comment on such unsuccessful actions of the police, decides to tell the truth about what really happened, and an anonymous source begins to send out copies of a secret report that analyzes the actions of the German police. With the help of an expert who specializes in intelligence tactics in hostage situations and analyzed almost 3,000 documents, the puzzle began to come together into a true picture. Our gripping one-hour film, based on eyewitness accounts, expert testimony and interviews with families of the victims, answers the key questions of this tragic event: how terrorists entered the Olympic village, why the police forces involved acted so unprofessionally, and whether it all could have been avoided. programme.title: HISTORY'S GREATEST MYSTERIES S6 EP03

programme.title: THE CURSE OF OAK ISLAND S12 EP25

programme.title: HISTORY'S GREATEST ESCAPES WITH MORGAN FREEMAN S2 EP14
programme.desc: Một người đàn ông có khát vọng viết tiểu thuyết tội phạm đã trở thành ngôi sao trong câu chuyện đột phá của chính mình khi anh ta cố gắng trốn thoát khỏi một trong những trang trại nhà tù lâu đời nhất và khét tiếng nhất Mississippi, Parchman Penitentiary.

programme.title: ALONE S11 EP01
programme.desc: Ở địa điểm xa xôi nhất của Alone, mười người sống sót mới phải sống sót ở phía bắc Vòng Bắc Cực khi họ đối mặt với cái lạnh và mặt trời đang suy yếu để có cơ hội giành được 500.000 đô la.

programme.title: THE UNBELIEVABLE WITH DAN AYKROYD S2 EP02
programme.desc: Bạn đã bao giờ thắc mắc về những điều kỳ lạ nhất từ ​​trên trời rơi xuống chưa? Từ thiên thạch đến hải sản và thậm chí cả bồn tắm, đây là những câu chuyện thực sự khó tin về những gì đến từ trên cao.
